0.criteria: settled only if arms (a), (b) and (c) all execute with per-case scores retained, the hard set is frozen and committed before any model call on it, the case author is not this agent, and the control passes only label-0 cases. 5.label: fix-round-2 preregistration, written after the second independent review (Opus) and before any fix-round-2 command
5.expectation: No rerun. The per-session hook attribution claim is withdrawn: real hook processes on this host are their own session leaders (pid == sid), so a hook spawned by the reviewed CLI would not share the call's setsid session. The detection method is restated on grounds the raw outputs already carry: both CLIs had hooks disabled by configuration, neither call produced tool activity (Claude --tools ""; codex-events.jsonl has no tool items), and every sampled hook process was a pre-tool-use/post-tool-use event, which a tool-less call cannot emit.
5.criteria: receipt 5 results.hooks and README rewritten; the poller's limitation stated; parent-pid ancestry marked as not captured; outcome unchanged (advanced) because the TypeSafe arm remains deferred.
